triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-component-go-manifestSubject
triples.object: manifestSubject is the NATS subject for publishing manifest events.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-component-go-querySubject
triples.object: querySubject is the NATS subject for request/reply source queries.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-component-go-summaryQuerySubject
triples.object:
summaryQuerySubject is the NATS subject for on-demand summary queries.

This is graph.query.SOURCE_summary, not graph.query.summary. The substrate's
graph-query serves graph.query.summary with a different payload
(graph.SummaryData), and both components run in one SemSource process — so
while source-manifest also subscribed there, the reply was a race between
two shapes and the subject had no contract. The consumer integration guide
always assigned graph.query.summary to graph-query; SemSource was the
squatter. Consumers wanting this payload use this subject or
GET /source-manifest/summary.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-maxAddBodyBytes
triples.object: maxAddBodyBytes bounds a source-registration request body (small JSON).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-ingestAddSubjectPrefix
triples.object:
ingestAddSubjectPrefix is the per-namespace prefix for source-add
requests: graph.ingest.add.{namespace}.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-ingestReadyWhen
triples.object:
ingestReadyWhen is the canonical readiness condition returned in
AddReply.ReadyWhen. Callers wait until the matching SourceStatus on
graph.ingest.status reports a phase in this set.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-ingestRemoveSubjectPrefix
triples.object:
ingestRemoveSubjectPrefix is the per-namespace prefix for
source-remove requests: graph.ingest.remove.{namespace}.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-lifecycleTriggerTimeout
triples.object:
lifecycleTriggerTimeout bounds the background NATS round trip
triggering a staleness lifecycle pass after remove_source. Fire-and-
forget from the caller's perspective — a missing or slow responder
degrades staleness marking, it never blocks or fails removal.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeInstanceExists
triples.object:
CodeInstanceExists indicates a component with the deterministic instance
name already exists with a different config. Idempotent re-submits with
matching configs return Created=false and no error instead.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeInternalError
triples.object:
CodeInternalError indicates an unexpected failure inside SemSource that
is not directly attributable to caller input or KV state (e.g. a wrapped
error from a future dependency that bypasses sourcespawn.Error). Treat
as retryable with backoff — distinct from VALIDATION_FAILED, which must
not be retried without changing the request.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeKVWriteFailed
triples.object:
CodeKVWriteFailed indicates the underlying ConfigManager KV write
failed. Retryable.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeNotFound
semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeUnsupportedType
triples.object:
CodeUnsupportedType indicates the SourceEntry.Type is not yet
implementable through this API (e.g., multi-branch repo).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-CodeValidationFailed
triples.object:
CodeValidationFailed indicates the SourceEntry did not pass type-specific
validation (missing required fields, invalid duration strings, etc.).
Not retryable — the caller must fix the input.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-SourceAuthFailed
triples.object:
SourceAuthFailed indicates an authentication or authorization failure
reaching the source (private repo without creds, 401/403 from URL).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-SourceUnreachable
triples.object:
SourceUnreachable indicates the source's origin could not be reached
(git clone 404, URL DNS fail, path missing).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-WatchFailed
triples.object:
WatchFailed indicates the watch subsystem (fsnotify, polling) failed
after the initial seed completed.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-readiness-go-ReadinessNote
triples.object:
ReadinessNote is the canonical prose contract for the readiness signals,
shared by the MCP source_status tool and the HTTP status endpoint. The
"miss means genuine absence" guarantee is scoped to BOTH gates: the
aggregate phase must be ready (every source finished its initial seed) and
the relevant index signal must be ready — during seeding a miss may simply
be not-yet-ingested (audit 2026-07-19, honest-readiness-and-errors).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-PhaseDegraded
triples.object: Phase constants for aggregate ingestion status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-PhaseReady
triples.object: Phase constants for aggregate ingestion status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-PhaseSeeding
triples.object: Phase constants for aggregate ingestion status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-predicatesQuerySubject
triples.object: predicatesQuerySubject is the NATS subject for on-demand predicate schema queries.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-predicatesSubject
triples.object: predicatesSubject is the NATS subject for publishing predicate schema.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusQuerySubject
triples.object: statusQuerySubject is the NATS subject for on-demand status queries.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusReportSubject
triples.object: statusReportSubject is the internal NATS subject for source status reports.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.const.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusSubject
triples.object: statusSubject is the NATS subject for publishing status to consumers.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.file.processor-source-manifest-config-go
triples.object:
Package sourcemanifest provides the source-manifest component for semsource.
It publishes a manifest of configured sources to the graph stream and
responds to NATS request/reply queries on graph.query.sources.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-component-go-NewComponent
triples.object: NewComponent creates a new source-manifest component.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-component-go-NewComponent
triples.object: func NewComponent(rawConfig json.RawMessage, deps component.Dependencies) (component.Discoverable, error)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-component-go-RequestSubjects
triples.object:
RequestSubjects returns every NATS request/reply subject this component
serves. It is derived from the same constants Start subscribes with, so the
list cannot drift from the subscriptions.

It exists so the subject-ownership guard can compare SemSource's claims
against the substrate's query surface without copying subject literals. A
subject served by both SemSource and the substrate is a race, not a
load-balanced pair: the requester takes whichever reply arrives first and
discards the other, and the two payloads are different shapes.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-component-go-parseDurationOrDefault
triples.object: parseDurationOrDefault parses a duration string with a fallback default.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-component-go-parseDurationOrDefault
triples.object: func parseDurationOrDefault(s string, def time.Duration) time.Duration

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-config-go-DefaultConfig
triples.object: DefaultConfig returns the default configuration for the source-manifest component.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-factory-go-Register
triples.object: Register registers the source-manifest component with the given registry.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-authorized
triples.object:
authorized enforces the optional bearer-token seam (ADR-0007 §6). An empty
token means permissive (trusted-network) — all callers allowed. The compare is
constant-time.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-httpStatusForIngestError
triples.object: httpStatusForIngestError maps a wire error code to an HTTP status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-writeJSON
triples.object: func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-mapSpawnError
triples.object:
mapSpawnError maps a sourcespawn.Error code onto the wire IngestErrorCode.
Non-typed errors (json decode failures, anything that bypasses
sourcespawn.Error wrapping) become INTERNAL_ERROR — retryable, distinct
from VALIDATION_FAILED. The decode-failure path is technically a caller
error, but we cannot distinguish it from genuine internal failures here;
callers should see INTERNAL_ERROR and inspect Message to decide.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-removeSub2
triples.object: removeSub2 returns subs with target removed (first match). Caller holds c.mu.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-lifecycle_scope-go-systemsForComponentConfig
triples.object:
systemsForComponentConfig decodes cc's stored JSON back into the
system-identifying fields each sourcespawn builder used to construct it,
mirroring the slug computation the runtime component itself performs.
Switches on the factory name (cc.Name) since the field shape differs by
source type. Unrecognized factories return nil.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-lifecycle_scope-go-systemsForRemovedInstance
triples.object:
systemsForRemovedInstance looks up instanceName's stored component config
(before it is deleted) and derives the entity-ID system slug(s) its
entities carry, so remove_source can scope the staleness lifecycle trigger
(source_removed marking) to exactly what the removed source produced.
Returns nil when the instance is unknown or its factory type isn't yet
resolvable — a soft miss: unmarked entities on removal was already the
pre-existing behavior for those cases, so this is purely additive.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-payload_registry-go-RegisterPayloads
triples.object:
RegisterPayloads registers the source-manifest payload types with the
supplied registry. Called from cmd/semsource/run.go during bootstrap.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-readiness-go-IndexReadinessJSON
triples.object:
IndexReadinessJSON is the exported form of indexReadinessFrom for the other
status surfaces (MCP gateway): one canonical readiness shape everywhere.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-readiness-go-IndexReadinessJSON
triples.object: func IndexReadinessJSON(raw []byte, err error, label string) json.RawMessage

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-readiness-go-indexReadinessFrom
triples.object:
indexReadinessFrom converts a raw graph index/embedding status reply (or the
error from fetching it) into the canonical readiness object. Failures yield
an explicit {available:false, reason} object — the signal agents gate on is
never silently omitted.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-readiness-go-indexReadinessFrom
triples.object: func indexReadinessFrom(raw []byte, err error, label string) workbenchIndexReadiness

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-status-go-buildPredicateSchema
triples.object: buildPredicateSchema constructs a PredicateSchemaPayload from the vocabulary registry.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-status-go-patternRole
triples.object: patternRole classifies predicates by their dotted-notation category segment.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.function.processor-source-manifest-status-go-predicateRole
triples.object: predicateRole classifies a predicate into a semantic role for consumers.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.interface.processor-source-manifest-factory-go-RegistryInterface
triples.object: RegistryInterface defines the minimal interface needed for registration.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-RegisterHTTPHandlers
triples.object:
RegisterHTTPHandlers registers the /sources, /status, /capabilities, and /predicates
endpoints on the ServiceManager's shared HTTP mux.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-Start
triples.object:
Start publishes the manifest and predicate schema, then begins
listening for source status reports and serving queries.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-buildSummary
triples.object:
buildSummary constructs a SummaryPayload from current aggregator state
and the predicate schema. Called on-demand for query responses.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-configuredSourceTypes
triples.object: configuredSourceTypes returns the unique source types from config.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-handleHealth
triples.object:
handleHealth serves a SemTeams UI-compatible health envelope derived from the
source-manifest component's live aggregate status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-handleSources
triples.object: handleSources serves the pre-marshaled manifest payload.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-handleStatus
triples.object: handleStatus serves the current aggregated status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-handleStatusReport
triples.object: handleStatusReport processes an incoming status report from a source component.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-handleSummary
triples.object: handleSummary serves a combined status and predicate schema response.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-publishManifest
triples.object:
publishManifest re-marshals the current manifest sources and publishes a
fresh ManifestPayload to manifestSubject. Caller must NOT hold manifestMu.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-publishPayload
triples.object: publishPayload marshals and publishes a payload to JetStream.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-publishPayload
triples.object: func (c *Component) publishPayload(ctx context.Context, msgType message.Type, payload message.Payload, subject string) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-requireRunning
triples.object:
requireRunning checks whether Start() has completed. If not, it writes a
503 Service Unavailable response and returns false.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-startManifest
triples.object: startManifest publishes the manifest and sets up query handlers.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-startPredicateSchema
triples.object: startPredicateSchema builds and publishes the predicate schema.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-startSeedTimeout
triples.object: startSeedTimeout sets a deadline for all sources to report.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-startStatusAggregation
triples.object:
startStatusAggregation subscribes to internal status reports, starts the
heartbeat loop, and sets up the seed timeout.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component-updateStatusData
triples.object: updateStatusData pre-marshals the latest status for query responses.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-config-go-Config-Validate
triples.object: Validate checks the configuration for errors.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-authorizedIngest
triples.object:
authorizedIngest runs the shared preconditions for the write/handle endpoints:
the component is running, the ingest config is wired, and the bearer token (if
configured) matches. On failure it writes the response and returns ok=false.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-handleAddHTTP
triples.object:
handleAddHTTP serves POST /sources — the HTTP face of the source-add path
(ADR-0007). It applies the transport-level guards (auth, path allowlist) then
delegates to the same addSource code path the NATS handler uses.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-handleRemoveHTTP
triples.object:
handleRemoveHTTP serves DELETE /sources/{id}. Removal stops ingestion but does
not retract entities (ADR-0007 sequencing guardrail).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-handleSourceHTTP
triples.object:
handleSourceHTTP serves GET /sources/{id} — resolves a registration handle to
its auditable SourceHandle (ADR-0007 §5/§6, HTTP-pollable).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-ingestConfig
triples.object:
ingestConfig returns the wired ingest config, or nil if the host has not yet
called RegisterIngestHandlers (startup race — handlers 503 while nil).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-sourceHandle
triples.object:
sourceHandle resolves an instance name back to a SourceHandle by finding the
registered manifest source whose sourcespawn expansion produces it.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-Component-sourceHandle
triples.object: func (c *Component) sourceHandle(instanceName string, opts sourcespawn.Options) (*SourceHandle, bool)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-RegisterIngestHandlers
triples.object:
RegisterIngestHandlers subscribes the component to graph.ingest.add and
graph.ingest.remove for the configured namespace. Subscriptions are
torn down by Stop along with the existing manifest/status subs.

This is wired by the host program (cmd/semsource/run.go) after the
ConfigManager is constructed and the component has Started, since the
component itself does not own a reference to the ConfigManager.

The component must be running before this is called — Stop short-circuits
when !running, so subs registered against a non-running component would
leak. The check below races with Stop, but since Stop also takes c.mu and
clears c.running, the worst interleaving is a registration that fails
cleanly mid-shutdown rather than leaking.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-RegisterIngestHandlers
triples.object: func (c *Component) RegisterIngestHandlers(ctx context.Context, cfg IngestHandlerConfig) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-addSource
triples.object:
addSource dispatches an AddRequest to sourcespawn and returns the AddReply. It
is the single source-add code path shared by the NATS ingest handler and the
HTTP façade (ADR-0007). Transport-level concerns (auth, path allowlisting)
are the caller's responsibility and must run BEFORE this.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-addSource
triples.object: func (c *Component) addSource(ctx context.Context, req AddRequest, cfg IngestHandlerConfig) *AddReply

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-appendManifestSources
triples.object:
appendManifestSources adds entries reflecting src to c.manifestSources. A
"repo" entry is recorded as itself (not its expanded children) so the
manifest preserves the caller's intent. Idempotent on the manifest level:
duplicate adds (same Type+identifier) are skipped.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-dropSourceStatus
triples.object:
dropSourceStatus removes a deregistered source from the status aggregator
and republishes the rebuilt status so the change is observable within one
aggregation pass. The instance is also remembered as removed so an
in-flight periodic report from the tearing-down component cannot resurrect
a phantom status entry.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-handleAddRequest
triples.object:
handleAddRequest validates an AddRequest, dispatches to sourcespawn, and
returns a marshaled AddReply. Errors in the reply envelope rather than
returning Go errors so callers always get a structured response.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-handleAddRequest
triples.object: func (c *Component) handleAddRequest(ctx context.Context, data []byte, cfg IngestHandlerConfig) ([]byte, error)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-handleRemoveRequest
triples.object: handleRemoveRequest deletes a component config from the KV store.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-handleRemoveRequest
triples.object: func (c *Component) handleRemoveRequest(ctx context.Context, data []byte, cfg IngestHandlerConfig) ([]byte, error)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-removeManifestSourceByInstance
triples.object:
removeManifestSourceByInstance keeps the manifest in sync with the KV on
removal, instance-scoped: for "repo" expansions (one manifest entry → many
instances) the entry is dropped only when the removed instance was the LAST
of its expansion still registered — removing just the git instance of an
expanded repo previously erased the whole repo from the manifest while its
sibling components kept ingesting (audit 2026-07-19).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-removeManifestSourceByInstance
triples.object: func (c *Component) removeManifestSourceByInstance(instanceName string, opts sourcespawn.Options, store sourcespawn.ConfigStore) bool

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-removeSource
triples.object:
removeSource deletes a component config from the KV store and returns the
RemoveReply. Shared by the NATS ingest handler and the HTTP façade. Removal
stops ingestion but does NOT retract entities — eager retraction is parked
behind the fact-layer provenance model (ADR-0007 sequencing guardrail).
Retained entities instead get a source_removed staleness marker
(entity-staleness spec D4), completing the removal-integrity deferral.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-removeSource
triples.object: func (c *Component) removeSource(ctx context.Context, instanceName, actor string, cfg IngestHandlerConfig) *RemoveReply

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-triggerRemovalLifecycleRun
triples.object:
triggerRemovalLifecycleRun announces the removed source's scope to the
staleness lifecycle pass (processor/supersession), fired in the background
so remove_source's caller is never blocked on a full graph pass.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-Component-triggerRemovalLifecycleRun
triples.object: func (c *Component) triggerRemovalLifecycleRun(ctx context.Context, org string, systems []string)

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-allReported
triples.object: allReported returns true when all expected sources have reported.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-allSeeded
triples.object:
allSeeded returns true when all expected sources have reported AND every
reported source is past its initial seed (watching or idle).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-anyErrored
triples.object: anyErrored returns true when any reported source is in the errored phase.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-buildStatus
triples.object: buildStatus constructs a StatusPayload from the current aggregated state.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-markDegraded
triples.object: markDegraded forces the aggregate to degraded phase (used on seed timeout).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-remove
triples.object:
remove drops a deregistered source's record so it stops appearing in status
(the audit found removed sources reported as phantom "watching" entries
forever). The expected count decrements with it — a removal means the
operator no longer expects that source — floored at zero so allReported
degenerates gracefully to "any source reported".

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.method.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator-update
triples.object: update records a status report and returns the current aggregate status.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-component-go-Component
triples.object:
Component implements the source-manifest processor.
On startup it publishes a ManifestPayload to the GRAPH stream and
subscribes to graph.query.sources for on-demand request/reply queries.
It also aggregates status reports from source components and publishes
ingestion status and predicate schema to consumers.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-component-go-HealthPayload
triples.object: HealthPayload is the UI-compatible health envelope served over HTTP.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-component-go-HealthSubStatus
triples.object: HealthSubStatus is an optional detail row consumed by SemTeams UI.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-config-go-Config
triples.object: Config holds configuration for the source-manifest component.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-config-go-ManifestSource
triples.object:
ManifestSource is the external-facing representation of a configured source.
It contains only the fields useful for downstream consumers to understand
what data SemSource is ingesting.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-http_sources-go-SourceHandle
triples.object:
SourceHandle is the auditable descriptor returned by GET /sources/{id}. It
resolves a registration handle (a component instance name) to the stable
metadata a long-running caller needs to prove which graph view it used
(ADR-0007 §5). ref/commit generation and indexed-at timestamps are follow-on,
gated on the fact-provenance model.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-ingest-go-IngestHandlerConfig
triples.object:
IngestHandlerConfig wires the ingest add/remove subscriptions on
source-manifest. Callers must supply both Store (KV writes) and Spawn
(per-source defaults). Namespace is the per-namespace subject suffix.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-AddReply
triples.object:
AddReply is the response to an AddRequest. Components is empty when Error
is non-nil. ReadyWhen describes the condition the caller can poll on
StatusSubject to know the source is graph-queryable (see ADR-0003).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-AddRequest
triples.object:
AddRequest registers a new source on the receiving SemSource instance.
Sent to graph.ingest.add.{namespace} as request/reply.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-AddedComponent
triples.object:
AddedComponent describes one component spawned by an add. A flat source
produces one; a "repo" meta-source produces multiple (git, ast, doc,
cfgfile).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-IngestError
triples.object: IngestError is the typed error envelope embedded in reply payloads.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-Provenance
triples.object:
Provenance carries caller-supplied attribution for an add or remove
request. Recorded on source metadata and forward-stamped on entity-event
provenance, but otherwise opaque to SemSource — its shape is whatever
SemTeams or other callers send (per ADR-0003 §"Authorization").

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-RemoveReply
triples.object: RemoveReply is the response to a RemoveRequest.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-RemoveRequest
triples.object:
RemoveRequest deregisters a source by instance name. Sent to
graph.ingest.remove.{namespace} as request/reply.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_predicates-go-PredicateDescriptor
triples.object: PredicateDescriptor describes a single predicate with its semantic role.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_predicates-go-PredicateSchemaPayload
triples.object:
PredicateSchemaPayload advertises the predicates emitted by each source type
with semantic role classification. Published to graph.ingest.predicates.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_predicates-go-SourcePredicateSchema
triples.object: SourcePredicateSchema describes the predicates a source type emits.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-SourceError
triples.object:
SourceError describes the most recent asynchronous failure for a source
instance. Cleared (nil) when the source recovers and is reporting healthy.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-SourceStatus
triples.object: SourceStatus reports the status of a single source instance.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-StatusPayload
triples.object:
StatusPayload reports the ingestion lifecycle phase and per-source status.
Published to graph.ingest.status on the GRAPH stream.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_summary-go-DomainSummary
triples.object: DomainSummary reports entity counts by type within a single domain.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_summary-go-SummaryPayload
triples.object:
SummaryPayload provides a comprehensive graph overview for agent bootstrap.
Combines status, entity type breakdown by domain, and predicate schema
into a single response. Served at GET /source-manifest/summary and
via NATS request/reply on graph.query.sourceSummary.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payload_summary-go-TypeCount
triples.object: TypeCount is an entity type and its count within a domain.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-payloads-go-ManifestPayload
triples.object:
ManifestPayload describes the configured sources for this SemSource instance.
Published to the GRAPH stream at startup and available via graph.query.sources.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-status-go-SourceStatusReport
triples.object:
SourceStatusReport is the internal message published by source components
to semsource.internal.status after initial ingest and periodically.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.struct.processor-source-manifest-status-go-statusAggregator
triples.object:
statusAggregator tracks per-source status reports and determines the
aggregate ingestion phase.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.type.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-IngestErrorCode
triples.object:
IngestErrorCode is a typed error code returned in ingest reply payloads.
Codes flow to remote callers so they can branch on retryability without
scraping log strings. See ADR-0003 for the full code list.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.type.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-SourceErrorCode
triples.object:
SourceErrorCode is a typed code for asynchronous source-runtime failures.
Codes flow to remote callers (subscribers of graph.ingest.status) so they
can branch on retryability without scraping log strings.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-factory-go-manifestSchema
triples.object: manifestSchema defines the configuration schema for the source-manifest component.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-AddReplyType
triples.object: AddReplyType is the message type for ingest add replies.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-AddRequestType
triples.object: AddRequestType is the message type for ingest add requests.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-RemoveReplyType
triples.object: RemoveReplyType is the message type for ingest remove replies.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_ingest-go-RemoveRequestType
triples.object: RemoveRequestType is the message type for ingest remove requests.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_predicates-go-PredicatesType
triples.object: PredicatesType is the message type for predicate schema payloads.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payload_status-go-StatusType
triples.object: StatusType is the message type for ingestion status payloads.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-payloads-go-ManifestType
triples.object: ManifestType is the message type for source manifest payloads.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-status-go-explicitRoles
triples.object: explicitRoles maps specific predicates to their semantic roles.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-source-manifest.var.processor-source-manifest-status-go-sourcePredicatePrefixes
triples.object: sourcePredicates maps source types to predicate prefixes.
